# Swift AI Humanizer

> Free AI Humanizer that turns ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini text into 100% human writing.

Swift AI Humanizer (https://swiftaihumanizer.com) is a free web application that converts synthetic AI text into natural human prose while preserving 100% of original formatting (bolding, bullet points, subheadings) and meaning. It is engineered to bypass AI detectors including Turnitin 2026, GPTZero v2, Copyleaks, Originality.ai 3.0, Sapling, ZeroGPT, and QuillBot.

## Key Features

- **Formatting Preservation**: Preserves Markdown and rich text formatting (bullet points, numbered lists, bold text, heading hierarchy).
- **5 Writing Tones**: Offers 5 specialized tone modes: Academic Paper, Conversational General, Professional Business, Persuasive Marketing, Creative Story.
- **Bulk Upload & Clipboard**: Supports bulk file upload (.docx, .txt) and direct rich-text HTML clipboard copy into Google Docs, Word, and Gmail.
- **Live AI Detection**: Real-time multi-detector AI risk scoring (Turnitin 2026, GPTZero v2, Copyleaks).
- **Privacy Architecture**: Ephemeral processing in server RAM with zero user text logging or selling.
